values.prompt:
Create a clean, neutral production character sheet for Ada using the universal identity layout.

## Face column and information
Place one large straight-on, centered, identity-readable face close-up in the first column, cropped above the shoulders. Below it show compact metadata: Name: Ada; Height: 5 ft 6 in / 168 cm; Synopsis: watchful courier in a simple travel dress. Below that metadata show the exact small brass hair clip as the only accessory detail. No angled portrait or torso study. Preserve auburn bob-length hair, pale freckled skin, narrow face, watchful expression, and slight forward tension in posture.

## Four full-length views
After the face column, show four complete full-length views in this exact order: FRONT, BACK, LEFT PROFILE, RIGHT PROFILE. Keep the same person, proportions, simple travel dress, boots, hair clip placement, and wardrobe layers in every view. Arms relaxed, feet visible, poses neutral and repeatable.

## Scale
Height is binding: 5 ft 6 in / 168 cm. Include one clearly labeled height ruler with numeric tick marks beside the full-body views. The ruler, written height, and body proportions must agree. Do not invent age, weight, or gender.

## Exclusions
No gesture panels, expression range, action poses, location shots, story scenes, tool demonstrations, material swatches, extra props, weapons, other characters, or extra studies.
